info.title: Marine Weather API -  Ocean & Coastal Weather Data
info.description: Retrieve marine and ocean weather data for coastal and offshore locations by GPS coordinates, city name/address, or IP address. Returns wave height, wave direction, wave period, wind-wave and swell statistics, sea surface temperature, sea level height, and ocean current speed/direction. Omit `startDate`/`endDate` to get current conditions, or pass both to get a forecast up to 16 days ahead at `daily`, `hourly`, or `minutely` precision via the `precision` parameter. For locations with no nearby ocean data (inland cities, landlocked coordinates), the endpoint still returns a `200` response with every marine field set to `null` instead of an error.

get.summary: Dive into detailed marine weather forecasts for coastal and offshore locations
get.description: Provides current or forecast marine conditions including wave height, wave direction, wave period, swell info, sea surface temperature, sea level height, and ocean currents. Accepts a location by GPS coordinates, city name/address, or IP address, and returns forecast data at daily, hourly, or minutely precision for up to 16 days ahead.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Starting date for marine forecast data in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be today or a future date, and must be supplied together with endDate — providing only one of the two returns a 400 error. The difference between endDate and startDate must not exceed 16 days.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for marine forecast data in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be today or a future date, and must be supplied together with startDate — providing only one of the two returns a 400 error. The difference between endDate and startDate must not exceed 16 days.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City name, place name, or full address.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4, IPv6, or hostname for location inference. Defaults to the caller's IP address when location, lat/long, and ip are all omitted.

parameters.name: precision
parameters.description: Precision of the marine forecast data. Only one of daily, hourly, or minutely is returned per request, matching this value. Default is daily.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone identifier used to localize the results (e.g. America/New_York). Returns a 400 error if not a recognized timezone.

200.description: Successful response — current marine conditions or a date-keyed forecast

inlandLocationNullData.summary: Inland location — all marine fields null

400.description: Bad Request — invalid or incomplete parameters

value.message: Invalid latitude or longitude values. Latitude must be between -90 and 90, and longitude must be between -180 and 180
Forecast date range must be within 2026-07-24 to 2026-08-08

404.description: Not Found — location could not be resolved

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

MarineResponse.description: Marine weather response. current and forecast are mutually exclusive: current is returned when startDate/endDate are omitted, forecast is returned when both are supplied. location is always present.

current.description: Current marine conditions. Present only when startDate/endDate are not supplied.

forecast.description: Date-keyed forecast data. Present only when startDate and endDate are both supplied.

LocationByCoordinates.description: Location data when the target is specified by GPS coordinates (lat/long).

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -90 (South Pole) to +90 (North Pole). Returned as a string, not a number.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -180 (West) to +180 (East). Returned as a string, not a number.

country_name.description: Full name of the country corresponding to the provided coordinates.

state_prov.description: State, province, or primary administrative division name for the location. Can be an empty string.

city.description: City or municipal area name associated with the coordinate location. Can be an empty string.

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, district, or village name within the broader area. Can be an empty string.

elevation.description: Height above mean sea level in meters for the specified coordinates. Returned as a string, not a number, and can be an empty string when unavailable.

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier for the location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London).

timezone_abbreviation.description: Abbreviated timezone representation based on current offset (e.g., EST, GMT, PST).

LocationByIP.description: Location data when the target is inferred from an IP address.

continent_code.description: Two-letter continent code (e.g., NA for North America, EU for Europe, AS for Asia).

continent_name.description: Full name of the continent where the IP address is registered.

country_code2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code (e.g., US, GB, FR).

country_code3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA).

country_name.description: Common name of the country associated with the IP address.

country_name_official.description: Official long-form country name as recognized internationally (e.g., United States of America).

is_eu.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country is a member state of the European Union.

state_prov.description: State, province, or primary administrative division associated with the IP location.

state_code.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for the state or province (e.g., CA for California).

district.description: District, county, or secondary administrative division within the region. Can be an empty string.

city.description: City or urban area name where the IP address is geographically registered.

zipcode.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the approximate location of the IP address. Can be an empty string.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for the IP geolocation, ranging from -90 to +90. Returned as a string, not a number.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for the IP geolocation, ranging from -180 to +180. Returned as a string, not a number.

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, or small area designation within the city. Can be an empty string.

elevation.description: Elevation above mean sea level in meters for the IP geolocation. Returned as a string, not a number, and can be an empty string when unavailable.

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier for the IP location (e.g., America/Chicago, Asia/Tokyo).

timezone_abbreviation.description: Current timezone abbreviation based on local offset (e.g., CST, JST, UTC).

LocationByAddress.description: Location data when the target is specified by a city name or address string.

location_string.description: Original location query string as submitted, including full address or place name.

country_name.description: Resolved country name derived from the geocoded location query.

state_prov.description: State, province, or primary administrative division identified from the location.

city.description: City or municipal area name extracted from the geocoded location.

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, suburb, or village within the geocoded area. Can be an empty string.

latitude.description: Geocoded latitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -90 to +90. Returned as a string, not a number.

longitude.description: Geocoded longitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -180 to +180. Returned as a string, not a number.

elevation.description: Elevation above mean sea level in meters at the geocoded coordinates. Returned as a string, not a number.

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier for the geocoded location (e.g., America/Los_Angeles).

timezone_abbreviation.description: Current timezone abbreviation for the location based on local offset (e.g., PDT, CET).

CurrentMarine.description: Current marine weather conditions including wave, swell, sea level, and current data. For locations with no nearby ocean data (inland/landlocked), every field below timestamp is returned as null instead of an error.

timestamp.description: Local timestamp of the current observation, in `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` format — not full ISO 8601 (no seconds, no timezone offset/`Z`).

wave_height.description: Significant height of combined sea waves in meters. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

wave_direction.description: Direction from which the combined waves are coming, in degrees. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

wave_period.description: Average period of combined sea waves in seconds. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

wind_wave_height.description: Height of locally generated wind waves in meters. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

wind_wave_direction.description: Direction from which the wind waves are coming, in degrees. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

wind_wave_period.description: Average period of locally generated wind waves in seconds. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

wind_wave_peak_period.description: Peak period of locally generated wind waves in seconds. Frequently null even at locations with other wave data present.

swell_wave_height.description: Height of swell waves in meters. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

swell_wave_direction.description: Direction from which the swell waves are coming, in degrees. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

swell_wave_period.description: Average period of swell waves in seconds. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

swell_wave_peak_period.description: Peak period of swell waves in seconds. Frequently null even at locations with other wave data present.

sea_level_height_msl.description: Sea level height relative to mean sea level in meters. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

sea_surface_temperature.description: Temperature of the ocean surface in degrees Celsius. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

ocean_current_velocity.description: Speed of the ocean current in km/h. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

ocean_current_direction.description: Direction of the ocean current, in degrees. Null where no ocean data is available for this location.

MarineDaily.description: Daily marine forecast summary with wave, wind-wave, and swell statistics for one day.

timestamp.description: Date of this forecast entry in YYYY-MM-DD format.

wave_height_max.description: Maximum significant wave height for the day, in meters.

wave_direction_dominant.description: Dominant direction of waves for the day, in degrees.

wave_period_max.description: Maximum wave period for the day, in seconds.

wind_wave_height_max.description: Maximum wind-driven wave height for the day, in meters.

wind_wave_direction_dominant.description: Dominant wind-wave direction for the day, in degrees.

wind_wave_period_max.description: Maximum wind-wave period for the day, in seconds.

wind_wave_peak_period_max.description: Maximum peak period of wind-driven waves for the day, in seconds. Frequently null.

swell_wave_height_max.description: Maximum swell wave height for the day, in meters.

swell_wave_direction_dominant.description: Dominant swell wave direction for the day, in degrees.

swell_wave_period_max.description: Maximum swell wave period for the day, in seconds.

swell_wave_peak_period_max.description: Maximum peak period of swell waves for the day, in seconds. Frequently null.

MarineHourly.description: Hourly marine weather reading with wave, swell, and sea surface data for a single hour.

timestamp.description: Local timestamp of this hourly entry, in `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` format — not full ISO 8601 (no seconds, no timezone offset/`Z`).

wave_height.description: Significant wave height at the given hour, in meters.

wave_direction.description: Wave direction at the given hour, in degrees.

wave_period.description: Wave period at the given hour, in seconds.

wind_wave_height.description: Wind-driven wave height at the given hour, in meters.

wind_wave_peak_period.description: Peak period of wind-driven waves at the given hour, in seconds.

wind_wave_direction.description: Wind-wave direction at the given hour, in degrees.

wind_wave_period.description: Wind-wave period at the given hour, in seconds.

swell_wave_height.description: Swell wave height at the given hour, in meters.

swell_wave_direction.description: Swell wave direction at the given hour, in degrees.

swell_wave_period.description: Swell wave period at the given hour, in seconds.

swell_wave_peak_period.description: Peak period of swell waves at the given hour, in seconds.

sea_surface_temperature.description: Sea surface temperature at the given hour, in degrees Celsius.

sea_level_height_msl.description: Sea level height relative to mean sea level at the given hour, in meters.

ocean_current_velocity.description: Speed of ocean current at the given hour, in km/h.

ocean_current_direction.description: Direction of ocean current at the given hour, in degrees.

MarineMinutely.description: Minute-by-minute marine data point for ocean current and sea level measurements.

timestamp.description: Local timestamp of this minute-level entry, in `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` format — not full ISO 8601 (no seconds, no timezone offset/`Z`).

ocean_current_velocity.description: Speed of ocean current at this minute, in km/h.

ocean_current_direction.description: Direction of ocean current at this minute, in degrees.

sea_level_height_msl.description: Sea level height relative to mean sea level at this minute, in meters.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

WeatherLocation.description: Location information. Shape depends on how the location was resolved (coordinates, IP, or address/city name).

oneOf.description: Location data when the target is specified by GPS coordinates (lat/long).
Location data when the target is inferred from an IP address.
Location data when the target is specified by a city name or address string.

MarineForecastData.description: Forecast data keyed by date (YYYY-MM-DD). Each key is a forecast date and its value is a MarineForecastDay.

MarineForecastDay.description: Marine forecast for a single day. Exactly one of daily, hourly, or minutely is present, matching whichever precision value was requested (default daily) — the other two are omitted, not just empty.

daily.description: Daily marine forecast summary. Present when precision=daily (the default).

hourly.description: Array of hourly marine readings for the day. Present when precision=hourly.

minutely.description: Array of minute-by-minute marine data points for the day. Present when precision=minutely.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
